name: Vanuatu
summary: Vanuatu levies no income tax on individuals or companies, no capital gains tax, no withholding tax and no estate or death duties (Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority). Revenue comes from 15% VAT, import duties, a 15% tax on rental income above VT 200,000 per six months and stamp duty of up to 1% on some property and share transfers. Vanuatu sells citizenship (from about USD 130,000, reported), but the EU suspended visa-free travel for Vanuatu passports over that programme.

regimes.name: Ordinary residence
regimes.description: No personal or corporate income tax, no capital gains, wealth or inheritance tax.
regimes.eligibility: No tax residence test is needed because there is no income tax; residence requires an immigration permit.

sources.title: No income and corporate tax (low-tax jurisdiction)

capital_gains.important_exceptions: Stamp duty of up to 1% (minimum VT 2,500) on some property transactions and share transfers. Corporate tax 'zero except on some real estate transactions' (VIPA).
capital_gains.rate_basis: VIPA: 'No capital gains tax' and 'No income or company tax: for residents'. All classes 0 (stamp duty is a transaction cost, not modelled).
capital_gains.professional_trader: No income tax, so no recharacterisation risk.
open_questions: Primary legislation not checked (Vanuatu has no income tax act). The VIPA tax page is partly stale (it still gives VAT as 12.5%; the other VIPA page gives 15%).

dividends.summary: No income tax on dividends, domestic or foreign, and no dividend withholding tax.

sources.title: No income and corporate tax (low-tax jurisdiction)

dividends.rate_basis: No income tax for individuals (VIPA). Source-country withholding on US/EU dividends is a final cost (no treaties).
dividends.treaty_network: No comprehensive tax treaties (general knowledge; not verified). US dividends bear 30% US WHT.
open_questions: Vanuatu has been on the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions for tax purposes (reported in a search summary, not verified); this can trigger defensive measures in EU source states.

wealth_tax.summary: No net wealth tax and no recurring levy on financial assets.

sources.title: No income and corporate tax (low-tax jurisdiction)

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: Not researched (land is held on long leases; rental income tax 15% above VT 200,000 per six months).

sources.title: No income and corporate tax (low-tax jurisdiction)

inheritance.gift_tax: No gift tax reported; stamp duty may apply to transfers of property or shares.
open_questions: Whether stamp duty applies to transfers of land leases or shares on death or by gift not verified.

residency.tax_residency_test: No income tax, so no tax residence test. Note that holding Vanuatu citizenship or residence does not by itself end tax residence elsewhere.

routes.name: Citizenship by investment (Development Support Program and related options)
routes.requirements: Reported government contribution about USD 130,000 for a single applicant plus about USD 25,000 for a spouse and further amounts per child, plus due diligence fees; no residence requirement (consultant guide, not verified against the Vanuatu Citizenship Commission). The EU partially suspended visa-free travel for Vanuatu passports issued since 25 May 2015 (Council decision March 2022), later reported as a full suspension; current status not verified. Citizenship alone gives no tax residence anywhere.

corporate.summary: No company income tax, 'except on some real estate transactions' (VIPA). VAT 15%. Offshore/international company regime exists (not researched).

sources.title: No income and corporate tax (low-tax jurisdiction)

us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain subject to US federal income, estate and gift tax on worldwide income and assets wherever they live; the app adds the federal layer. Where local tax on portfolio income is nil there is nothing to credit against US tax.
open_questions: Official Vanuatu Citizenship Commission pages could not be reached; programme amounts are from a consultant guide.
Current EU visa-waiver status for Vanuatu passports and current EU non-cooperative-list status not verified.
